scope: Short checkpoint rollout scaling; later sections record PPO continuation, parameter fits, capacity and transitions separately.

rollout_protocol.ordering: Sequential MPM then particles at 16, 64, 256, 512 environments.
rollout_protocol.timed_work: Policy inference, physics, observations, rewards, resets and curriculum.
rollout_protocol.quality_limit: Terminal outcomes cover a short changing episode population, not training convergence or a material equivalence claim.
rollout_protocol.baseline: MPM Q1/P0, pic27 contact, at most 24 Jacobi sweeps, tolerance 1e-4; particle stage uses 2 local iterations.
rollout_protocol.source_note: A later isolated XPBD fix changes positive-cohesion tangential behavior. These runs use zero cohesion; their exact measured source fingerprints remain in each record.
rollout_protocol.reset_population_note: Each process starts a fresh adaptive reset sampler. Environment count and terminal outcomes affect later replay rows; quality counters are not paired fixed-trajectory numerical errors.

ppo_continuation_protocol.timed_work: PPO collection, optimization, logging and final checkpoint save, after 16 warmup and 96 separately timed rollout steps.
ppo_continuation_protocol.quality_limit: Short continuation demonstrates working optimization and throughput, not converged policy quality or successful sim-to-sim transfer.

s2_and_particle_fit_protocol.limits: Short single-seed adaptive episode populations; iteration counts are upper budgets for MPM with nonzero tolerance.

adaptive_protocol.limits: Threshold-zero run tests the transition mechanism and optimizer continuity, not natural policy readiness or curriculum effectiveness.

capacity_protocol.purpose: Completed memory/capacity probes; not maximum-capacity or usable-policy-quality claims.
capacity_protocol.reason: Groups may overlap GPU0 video capture/compilation or the functional active-grid PPO probe while running on GPU1. All capacity rates are excluded from throughput comparisons.
capacity_protocol.outcome_note: Workspace guard counts environment term activations, not escaped particles; final finiteness does not exclude failures before automatic resets.
capacity_protocol.failure_at_8192_mpm: CUDAerror2 out of memory during initial sparse-grid allocation (wp_alloc_device_async and volume_builder rebuild_count_points), followed by RuntimeError: Failed to create volume. Later cleanup error700 messages are secondary.
capacity_protocol.quality_limit: A completed finite final state is not proof of a usable training batch. Autoreset may clear earlier bad states, workspace-guard flags are not wall-tunneling diagnoses, and adaptive reset populations differ.

active_grid_resize_protocol.note: Both runs start from checkpoint6997. The three-iteration run did not trigger; a separately preserved five-iteration run rebuilds an already-active grid at policy step355 inside PPO20..500. A threshold-zero mechanism test is not evidence of natural policy readiness.

video_protocol.comparison: Closed-loop pretrained policy, same camera, independent automatic episode resets. This illustrates changed behavior and is not a fidelity-equivalence test.
